dorsal_lateral_high_contrast_texture_top.macro_annuli_edge_geometry: The mid-body region features irregular, non-uniform O-shaped structures with high-contrast, jagged perimeters. The gradient transitions sharply from dark exterior pixels to lighter, diffused interior regions, particularly prominent in the upper-lateral quadrant.
dorsal_lateral_high_contrast_texture_top.high_intensity_blob_density: Moderate spatial density of solid, high-intensity pixel clusters located primarily along the lower-mid flank. These clusters lack internal gradients and appear as isolated, asymmetrical nodes between larger annular patterns.
dorsal_lateral_high_contrast_texture_top.constellation_keypoints: The centroids of the three largest macro-annuli in the central dorsal region form an obtuse scalene triangle. A secondary geometric relationship is formed by a linear chain of four high-intensity blobs oriented parallel to the longitudinal axis of the lower flank.

other_distinctive_markers: A complex interlocking figure-eight configuration of high-contrast pixels is visible in the central-lateral zone, forming a localized lattice structure distinct from isolated annuli.
